fields.sections.0.ko: Google introduces Gemini 4 Argon as its latest frontier intelligence model, positioning it as a tool for solving challenging problems in science, mathematics, robotics, and cybersecurity. Researchers, engineers, and security specialists are collaborating with this model to accelerate scientific discovery and practical impact. In fact, Google and academic researchers are using Argon to shorten the path from fundamental discovery to real-world application.
fields.sections.1.ko: One of Argon's core capabilities is the ability to automatically convert original video into simulation that follows physical laws. The model estimates depth and physical boundaries from video, then directly writes simulation code that recreates that environment. This capability demonstrates significant potential to reduce manual work across diverse fields including 3D environment modeling, robotics, and game development.
fields.sections.2.ko: Argon achieved first place with a score of 68% on the CWE-Bench (vulnerability improvement evaluation) benchmark, and it also surpasses previous models in resistance to indirect prompt injection attacks. The Chrome team used Argon to complete an architectural refactoring of Chromium's 40 million lines of codebase in weeks instead of months, separating approximately 6 million lines of legacy folders from core webpage processing logic. This improvement enables webpages to move seamlessly between tabs, side panels, and floating windows without refreshing, eliminating one category of browser crashes.
fields.sections.3.ko: Google researchers used Argon to enhance the performance of xTB, an open-source quantum chemistry package. Molecular structure prediction speed improved by up to 2.3x, and conformer searches accelerated 1.8x, with these improvements contributed to the official xTB repository on GitHub. Additionally, in Google's open-source Agent Development Kit (ADK), Argon autonomously identified optimizations that remove framework overhead, reducing memory setup time for long sessions by 40% and accelerating cold imports by 21%.
fields.sections.4.ko: Argon achieved approximately 2.85x inference speed improvement through vLLM, increasing throughput from approximately 37,900 tokens per second to over 108,000 tokens per second on A100. It maintained perfect token compatibility without quality degradation while implementing this in just days, work that typically takes months. Additionally, Argon discovered over 16 hidden timeouts and race condition bugs while migrating 700+ Google Skills training labs from hardcoded system images and runtimes distributed across five code repositories, saving 955 hours of engineering time.
fields.sections.5.ko: Argon demonstrates major advances over previous Gemini models in spatial reasoning, mathematical accuracy, and visual coding capability. These enhanced abilities translate into tangible results in complex 3D scene generation, fine-grained architectural modeling through multi-agent visual critique loops, and transforming real photographs into playable games. It demonstrated the capability to write custom 3D ray-tracing engines in pure Python without external libraries, and create complex games for the web using Three.js and GLSL shaders.
fields.sections.6.ko: Isomorphic Labs partnered with Argon for drug discovery research, reducing information extraction time from complex PDFs and patents from weeks to hours. In healthcare, Argon achieved the highest recall and ICD-10 code specificity across over 200 complex medical charts, demonstrating applicability to clinical review workflows through long-context understanding capability. In financial analysis, it achieved over 99% numerical accuracy from SEC documents, spanning from multi-year financial statement compilation to corporate valuation involving complex capital structures and M&A. In the legal field, it demonstrated strong performance in contract review, complaint analysis, and legal research, sometimes discovering legally relevant details that exceeded human expert responses in certain evaluations.
fields.sections.7.ko: According to Box's evaluation, Argon achieves 14% improvement in accuracy over Gemini 3.1 Pro, positioning it at the forefront of enterprise knowledge work. It connects evidence dispersed across various documents and completes multi-step analysis including hidden details in diagrams. In Qualia, an autonomous AI researcher project, Argon demonstrated frontier performance on complex multi-step research tasks while completing them 1.5x faster than peer models at one-quarter the cost. It achieved top ranking in Roboflow's object detection evaluation and demonstrated leading performance in text benchmarks in manufacturing, logistics, and aviation imagery domains.
fields.sections.8.ko: Argon reformatted unstructured project materials into clean proposal slides, or synthesized 50 gigabytes of aerial lidar scans, GIS vectors, congressional library CAD drawings, and national park archives to reconstruct a 3D model of Chaco Canyon. This exemplifies converting fragmented archaeological records into searchable digital heritage. It integrated data from three open-source repositories to create a medical learning tool enabling exploration of anatomical layers, inspection of clinical metadata, and navigation of 3D human biomechanics. These cases demonstrate Argon's ability to integrate large-scale heterogeneous data into meaningful forms.
fields.caveat: The original text is Google's official marketing material, and the performance figures and evaluations presented are primarily based on internal benchmarks from Google and early access partners, requiring independent verification, with potential performance variance in actual market application.
